:::{#def-locally-decodable}
#### Locally decodable code

A [block code](#def-block-code) $E$ is **locally decodable**
with $r$ queries and error fraction $\delta$
if there is a randomized decoder with the following property.
For every message $x$,
every word $w$ that differs from $E(x)$ in at most a fraction $\delta$ of its positions,
and every index $i$,
the decoder, given $i$ and access to $w$, reads at most $r$ symbols of $w$
and outputs $x_i$ with probability at least $2/3$ over its random choices.

:::
